30:all.name: Học Bá · Unit 1 · câu 1–20
30:all.text:
Câu 1. I always carry my keys in my pocket. That's why I never ___ them.
	A. miss
	B. remember
	*C. lose
Câu 2. ___ work in an office?
	A. Does you
	*B. Do you
	C. Doesn't you
Câu 3. I don't want to wait for a bus. I'm ___! I prefer to walk.
	A. lazy
	*B. impatient
	C. patient
Câu 4. ___ to bring your laptop tomorrow.
	*A. Remember
	B. Remind
	C. Expect
Câu 5. I ___ coffee after dinner.
	*A. hardly ever drink
	B. drink hardly ever
	C. don't hardly ever drink
Câu 6. Many people join clubs to ___ new people.
	A. meet up
	*B. meet
	C. learn
Câu 7. Megan is ___. Her profile says she's 24 and works in a bank, but she's 20 and she's a student.
	*A. dishonest
	B. serious
	C. sociable
Câu 8. I'm very busy at work right now. ___ I relax at home on the weekend.
	A. Because
	*B. That's why
	C. So that
Câu 9. Julia wants to be a TV host because they ___ a lot of money.
	A. win
	*B. earn
	C. take
Câu 10. Tim ___ at his friend's house for two weeks.
	A. stays
	B. are staying
	*C. is staying
Câu 11. Are you OK, Pilar? You ___ sick.
	A. look like
	*B. look
	C. 're looking like
Câu 12. My new neighbors are really ___. They never say hello.
	A. patient
	*B. rude
	C. polite
Câu 13. Many people say they want to ___ more time with their families.
	A. win
	B. lose
	*C. spend
Câu 14. This lemon cake ___ me of my grandmother.
	A. tells
	B. remembers
	*C. reminds
Câu 15. What do you do to ___ in shape?
	A. look
	*B. stay
	C. go
Câu 16. She leaves the house late, so she ___ stressed when she gets to work.
	A. are always
	B. always is
	*C. is always
Câu 17. In my free time, I'm learning ___.
	A. records
	B. movies
	*C. the guitar
Câu 18. I don't usually enjoy parties because I'm very ___.
	A. sociable
	*B. shy
	C. selfish
Câu 19. There are a lot of people in here. I'll ___ for you outside.
	A. hope
	B. meet
	*C. wait
Câu 20. I love social media. I ___ blogs from my favorite artists every day.
	A. am reading
	B. do read
	*C. read
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy keys in my pocket (luôn để chìa khóa trong túi) → chọn lose (làm mất) · never lose = không bao giờ làm mất
Câu 2: Thấy you ở câu hỏi → chọn Do you · you đi với Do, không đi với Does
Câu 3: Thấy don't want to wait (không muốn chờ) → chọn impatient (thiếu kiên nhẫn)
Câu 4: Thấy ___ to bring (không có người phía sau) → chọn Remember (nhớ làm gì)
Câu 5: Thấy hardly ever (hầu như không) → đặt trước động từ, không thêm don't → chọn hardly ever drink
Câu 6: Thấy new people → chọn meet · meet new people = làm quen người mới
Câu 7: Thấy hồ sơ ghi sai tuổi và nghề (nói dối) → chọn dishonest (không trung thực)
Câu 8: Thấy bận → nên nghỉ ở nhà (lý do → kết quả, đứng đầu câu) → chọn That's why (vì thế)
Câu 9: Thấy money (tiền lương) → chọn earn · earn money = kiếm tiền
Câu 10: Thấy Tim + for two weeks (ở tạm) → chọn is staying
Câu 11: Thấy sick (tính từ) ngay sau → chọn look · look + tính từ = trông có vẻ
Câu 12: Thấy never say hello (không bao giờ chào) → chọn rude (bất lịch sự)
Câu 13: Thấy time with (thời gian bên ai) → chọn spend · spend time = dành thời gian
Câu 14: Thấy me of (gợi cho tôi nhớ đến) → chọn reminds
Câu 15: Thấy in shape → chọn stay · stay in shape = giữ dáng
Câu 16: Thấy always + is → is đứng trước always → chọn is always
Câu 17: Thấy learning + nhạc cụ → chọn the guitar (học chơi đàn)
Câu 18: Thấy don't enjoy parties (không thích tiệc) → chọn shy (nhút nhát)
Câu 19: Thấy for you (đợi bạn) → chọn wait · wait for = đợi
Câu 20: Thấy I + every day (thói quen) → chọn read (động từ gốc)

31:all.name: Học Bá · Unit 1 · câu 21–40
31:all.text:
Câu 1. Wei goes to a lot of concerts and she always ___ about them.
	*A. blogs
	B. tells
	C. says
Câu 2. Mark ___ to the bus stop because his bus leaves in two minutes.
	A. runs
	B. is runing
	*C. is running
Câu 3. I get exercise every morning. I ___ before work.
	A. never go to the gym
	B. go usually to the gym
	*C. usually go to the gym
Câu 4. In many countries, it isn't ___ to answer your cell phone when you're in a meeting.
	*A. polite
	B. kind
	C. hard-working
Câu 5. My sister's wedding is tomorrow, so I ___ it doesn't rain.
	A. expect
	B. look like
	*C. hope
Câu 6. I ___ online for all my clothes.
	A. meet
	B. blog
	*C. shop
Câu 7. Please be ___ while we fix the computers.
	A. serious
	*B. patient
	C. honest
Câu 8. Where ___ now?
	A. go you
	B. do you go
	*C. are you going
Câu 9. Clara ___ lunch at home.
	*A. doesn't have
	B. don't have
	C. has not
Câu 10. ___ Max not to wait for me.
	A. Say
	*B. Tell
	C. Remember
Câu 11. My sister loves baking cupcakes. She's very ___, so she takes them to work.
	A. sociable
	*B. generous
	C. hard-working
Câu 12. Ricardo ___ soccer with me every Saturday morning.
	A. does
	*B. plays
	C. goes
Câu 13. I ___ a coat because it's hot today.
	*A. 'm not wearing
	B. don't wear
	C. not wearing
Câu 14. We are all working hard now ___ the exam is next week.
	A. so
	*B. because
	C. that's why
Câu 15. Please ___ me your books at the end of class.
	A. carry
	B. take
	*C. give
Câu 16. They ___ TV at night.
	A. don't never watch
	*B. never watch
	C. are never watching
Câu 17. Amy ___ this weekend because she has an exam next week.
	*A. is studying
	B. studies
	C. studys
Câu 18. My brother thinks he's ___. He tries to make everyone laugh.
	*A. funny
	B. nice
	C. polite
Câu 19. My friend ___ home from work.
	A. drives often
	B. is often driving
	*C. often drives
Câu 20. I live near a gym, but I'm lazy, ___ I never go.
	*A. so
	B. because
	C. that's why
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy about them (viết về các buổi hòa nhạc) → chọn blogs (viết blog)
Câu 2: Thấy bus leaves in two minutes (đang vội) → chọn is running (đang chạy, nhớ 2 chữ n)
Câu 3: Thấy every morning → chọn usually go to the gym · usually đứng trước động từ
Câu 4: Thấy answer your phone in a meeting (nghe điện thoại trong cuộc họp) → chọn polite · it isn't polite = bất lịch sự
Câu 5: Thấy it doesn't rain (mong trời không mưa) → chọn hope (hy vọng)
Câu 6: Thấy online for all my clothes (mua quần áo trên mạng) → chọn shop
Câu 7: Thấy while we fix (chờ sửa máy) → chọn patient (kiên nhẫn)
Câu 8: Thấy now + câu hỏi → chọn are you going
Câu 9: Thấy Clara (một người) + phủ định → chọn doesn't have
Câu 10: Thấy Max not to wait (người + not to) → chọn Tell · tell ai làm gì = bảo ai
Câu 11: Thấy takes them to work (mang bánh cho mọi người) → chọn generous (hào phóng)
Câu 12: Thấy soccer (môn có bóng) → chọn plays
Câu 13: Thấy because it's hot today (hôm nay nóng) → chọn 'm not wearing
Câu 14: Thấy the exam is next week (lý do, ở giữa câu) → chọn because (vì)
Câu 15: Thấy me your books (người + đồ) → chọn give (đưa cho)
Câu 16: Thấy never (đã là "không") → không thêm don't → chọn never watch
Câu 17: Thấy this weekend (chỉ dịp này) → chọn is studying
Câu 18: Thấy make everyone laugh (làm mọi người cười) → chọn funny (hài hước)
Câu 19: Thấy My friend (một người) + often → chọn often drives · often đứng trước động từ
Câu 20: Thấy lazy → never go (lười → không đi, lý do → kết quả) → chọn so (nên)

32:all.name: Học Bá · Unit 2 · câu 1–20
32:all.text:
Câu 1. Aydin ___ in 2010 and he went to elementary school in 2015.
	*A. was born
	B. grew up
	C. got born
Câu 2. I couldn't watch the TV show about snakes last night because I find them ___.
	A. interesting
	*B. terrifying
	C. terrified
Câu 3. The traffic light turned red and the cars ___.
	A. stoped
	*B. stopped
	C. stop
Câu 4. ___ does she remind you of?
	A. How
	*B. Who
	C. Whose
Câu 5. My sister's wedding was ___ August 15th.
	A. at
	B. in
	*C. on
Câu 6. My cell phone rang when I was in the theater. It was really ___.
	*A. embarrassing
	B. exciting
	C. confusing
Câu 7. Pamela went to ___ and studied to be a dentist.
	A. high school
	B. a career
	*C. college
Câu 8. Magda ___ her new boyfriend to the party.
	A. taked
	B. taken
	*C. took
Câu 9. What ___ about the accident?
	*A. did your mom say
	B. said your mom
	C. your mom did say
Câu 10. My brother started driving lessons in October. Three months ___, he bought a car.
	*A. later
	B. late
	C. after
Câu 11. We went to bed at 2 a.m. and got up at 6 a.m., so we're very ___.
	A. bored
	*B. tired
	C. relaxed
Câu 12. Yesterday, Alicia ___ a cake for her son's birthday.
	*A. baked
	B. did bake
	C. bakes
Câu 13. ___ to the meeting about the new office?
	A. Went you
	B. Did go you
	*C. Did you go
Câu 14. My parents didn't want me to ___ at sixteen, but I wanted to get a job as soon as possible.
	A. get married
	*B. finish school
	C. retire
Câu 15. They ___ happy with the new website because it was difficult to use.
	*A. weren't
	B. wasn't
	C. didn't be
Câu 16. ___ are they annoyed?
	A. How
	B. What
	*C. Why
Câu 17. They can't come to the wedding. It's ___.
	A. disappointed
	B. annoyed
	*C. disappointing
Câu 18. ___ sociable are you?
	*A. How
	B. How often
	C. Where
Câu 19. They didn't love each other any more, so they got ___.
	A. engaged
	*B. a divorce
	C. married
Câu 20. I met my husband ___.
	*A. five years ago
	B. past five years
	C. in five years
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy in 2010 (năm sinh) → chọn was born (được sinh ra)
Câu 2: Thấy snakes (con rắn làm mình sợ) → chọn terrifying · vật gây sợ dùng -ing
Câu 3: Thấy turned (quá khứ) → chọn stopped (nhớ 2 chữ p)
Câu 4: Thấy remind you of (gợi nhớ đến ai) → chọn Who (ai)
Câu 5: Thấy August 15th (ngày cụ thể) → chọn on
Câu 6: Thấy phone rang in the theater (điện thoại reo trong rạp) → chọn embarrassing (ngượng)
Câu 7: Thấy studied to be a dentist (học làm nha sĩ) → chọn college (đại học)
Câu 8: Thấy her new boyfriend to the party (chuyện đã xảy ra) → chọn took (quá khứ của take)
Câu 9: Thấy What ___ about the accident? (hỏi chuyện đã qua) → chọn did your mom say
Câu 10: Thấy Three months ___, (3 tháng sau) → chọn later
Câu 11: Thấy ngủ lúc 2 giờ, dậy lúc 6 giờ → chọn tired (mệt)
Câu 12: Thấy Yesterday → chọn baked (thêm -ed)
Câu 13: Thấy ___ to the meeting? (hỏi chuyện đã qua) → chọn Did you go
Câu 14: Thấy at sixteen + get a job (16 tuổi muốn đi làm) → chọn finish school (học xong phổ thông)
Câu 15: Thấy They + chuyện đã qua → chọn weren't
Câu 16: Thấy annoyed (bực mình, hỏi lý do) → chọn Why (tại sao)
Câu 17: Thấy It's (sự việc) → chọn disappointing · sự việc dùng -ing
Câu 18: Thấy sociable (tính từ) ngay sau → chọn How · How + tính từ = ... đến mức nào
Câu 19: Thấy didn't love each other (hết yêu) → chọn a divorce (ly hôn)
Câu 20: Thấy met (quá khứ) → chọn five years ago (5 năm trước)

33:all.name: Học Bá · Unit 2 · câu 21–40
33:all.text:
Câu 1. I was ___ to hear that my friend from elementary school worked in a zoo. She always hated animals.
	A. amazing
	B. surprising
	*C. surprised
Câu 2. ___ crying?
	A. Why you are
	*B. Why are you
	C. Why do you be
Câu 3. We had coffee, ___ we went to the movies.
	A. then after
	B. after then
	*C. then
Câu 4. "Did you go out on Saturday night?" "No, I ___."
	A. not
	*B. didn't
	C. don't
Câu 5. After a busy day at work, I think swimming is very ___.
	A. tired
	B. interesting
	*C. relaxing
Câu 6. They met in 1984 and immediately ___.
	A. fell on love
	*B. fell in love
	C. got in love
Câu 7. ___ does she start her new job?
	*A. When
	B. How long
	C. What
Câu 8. Please could you explain that again? I'm really ___.
	A. confusing
	*B. confused
	C. annoyed
Câu 9. My grandmother was married for ten years before she ___ children.
	A. got
	B. born
	*C. had
Câu 10. I couldn't buy it because I ___ any money in my wallet.
	A. didn't had
	*B. didn't have
	C. don't had
Câu 11. I waited for you at the café, but ___, I decided to go home.
	*A. after 40 minutes
	B. 40 minutes after
	C. later 40 minutes
Câu 12. Isabel is ___ in geography. She's going to study it at college.
	A. excited
	B. bored
	*C. interested
Câu 13. How ___ children did your grandparents have?
	A. old
	B. much
	*C. many
Câu 14. Diego is a famous chef now, but he ___ his career in a fast food restaurant.
	A. got
	*B. started
	C. had
Câu 15. The results of the competition were very ___.
	A. disappointed
	*B. surprising
	C. tiring
Câu 16. Which video game ___ yesterday?
	A. are you play
	*B. did you play
	C. do you play
Câu 17. Where were you ___ three o'clock?
	*A. at
	B. on
	C. last
Câu 18. I retired in 2005. ___, I took care of my grandchildren.
	A. After then
	*B. After that
	C. After
Câu 19. ___ is your middle name?
	A. How
	B. Who
	*C. What
Câu 20. George got engaged to Helen ___.
	A. past year
	B. year ago
	*C. last year
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy I was (người cảm thấy) + ngạc nhiên → chọn surprised · người dùng -ed
Câu 2: Thấy crying (đang khóc) → chọn Why are you
Câu 3: Thấy uống cà phê, ___ đi xem phim (việc 1 rồi việc 2) → chọn then (rồi)
Câu 4: Thấy câu hỏi Did you...? → chọn didn't
Câu 5: Thấy swimming (bơi là một việc) → chọn relaxing · việc dùng -ing
Câu 6: Thấy met (gặp nhau) + yêu → chọn fell in love (nhớ chữ in)
Câu 7: Thấy start her new job (hỏi lúc nào bắt đầu) → chọn When
Câu 8: Thấy I'm + explain again (giải thích lại) → chọn confused (bối rối) · người dùng -ed
Câu 9: Thấy children → chọn had · have children = có con
Câu 10: Thấy didn't → động từ gốc → chọn didn't have
Câu 11: Thấy 40 minutes (sau 40 phút) → chọn after 40 minutes · after đứng trước
Câu 12: Thấy in geography (thích môn học) → chọn interested · interested in = thích
Câu 13: Thấy children (đếm được) → chọn many · How many = bao nhiêu
Câu 14: Thấy his career (sự nghiệp) → chọn started · start a career = bắt đầu sự nghiệp
Câu 15: Thấy The results (sự việc) → chọn surprising · sự việc dùng -ing
Câu 16: Thấy yesterday + câu hỏi → chọn did you play
Câu 17: Thấy three o'clock (giờ) → chọn at
Câu 18: Thấy ___, I took care (đầu câu, có dấu phẩy) → chọn After that (sau đó)
Câu 19: Thấy name (hỏi tên) → chọn What
Câu 20: Thấy got engaged (chuyện đã qua) → chọn last year (năm ngoái)

34:all.name: Học Bá · Unit 3 · câu 1–20
34:all.text:
Câu 1. My hair is really ___. I didn't brush it this morning.
	A. lively
	B. modern
	*C. messy
Câu 2. I ___ my wallet when we were in New York.
	A. losed
	B. was losing
	*C. lost
Câu 3. Slow down! I can't walk ___ you.
	*A. as fast as
	B. faster as
	C. so fast as
Câu 4. On our last vacation, we stayed at a ___.
	A. camping
	*B. hotel
	C. museum
Câu 5. Some of the students were waiting ___ outside the exam room.
	A. nervous
	B. nervousily
	*C. nervously
Câu 6. Would you like to ___ a single or a double room?
	*A. reserve
	B. stay
	C. buy
Câu 7. The city is very ___. Bike riders often cover their faces.
	A. lively
	B. crowded
	*C. polluted
Câu 8. Mateo's English is ___ than mine.
	A. badder
	B. worser
	*C. worse
Câu 9. They ___ by the pool at 6:00 yesterday evening.
	A. was sunbathing
	*B. were sunbathing
	C. did sunbathing
Câu 10. This is the ___ train to New York. It stops at all the stations.
	A. slowly
	*B. slow
	C. good
Câu 11. Tokyo is a ___ city with tall buildings and a lot of new technology.
	*A. modern
	B. ancient
	C. fast
Câu 12. My wife likes to ___ camping, but I prefer hotels.
	A. stay at
	B. do
	*C. go
Câu 13. I think beach vacations are ___ city breaks.
	A. most relaxing than
	*B. more relaxing than
	C. as relaxing than
Câu 14. The Colosseum is the most famous ___ building in Rome.
	*A. ancient
	B. ugly
	C. unusual
Câu 15. What was Tomás wearing when we ___ him yesterday? He looked amazing.
	A. were seeing
	*B. saw
	C. was seeing
Câu 16. "Could I please use your pen?" she asked ___.
	A. angrily
	B. patiently
	*C. politely
Câu 17. She was traveling in India ___ she met her husband.
	*A. when
	B. while
	C. so
Câu 18. Santiago can play the piano very ___.
	A. goodly
	B. good
	*C. well
Câu 19. This part of the town is very ___ in the evenings because there are lots of cafés and restaurants.
	A. quiet
	*B. lively
	C. ugly
Câu 20. I go to work by bus because it's ___ the subway.
	A. the least crowded than
	*B. not as crowded as
	C. less crowded as
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy didn't brush it (không chải tóc) → chọn messy (rối)
Câu 2: Thấy wallet + when we were (chuyện đã qua) → chọn lost (quá khứ của lose)
Câu 3: Thấy can't walk ___ you (so bằng) → chọn as fast as
Câu 4: Thấy stayed at a (ở lại) → chọn hotel
Câu 5: Thấy were waiting (tả cách chờ) → chọn nervously · tả cách làm dùng -ly
Câu 6: Thấy a single or a double room (đặt phòng) → chọn reserve
Câu 7: Thấy cover their faces (phải che mặt) → chọn polluted (ô nhiễm)
Câu 8: Thấy than + bad → chọn worse (tệ hơn)
Câu 9: Thấy They + at 6:00 yesterday (giờ cụ thể trong quá khứ) → chọn were sunbathing
Câu 10: Thấy stops at all the stations (dừng mọi ga) → chọn slow (chậm)
Câu 11: Thấy tall buildings + new technology (nhà cao, công nghệ mới) → chọn modern (hiện đại)
Câu 12: Thấy camping → chọn go · go camping = đi cắm trại
Câu 13: Thấy than + relaxing (chữ dài) → chọn more relaxing than
Câu 14: Thấy The Colosseum (công trình rất cổ) → chọn ancient (cổ xưa)
Câu 15: Thấy when we ___ him yesterday (việc ngắn, chen ngang) → chọn saw
Câu 16: Thấy Could I please (hỏi lịch sự) → chọn politely
Câu 17: Thấy was traveling (việc dài) + met (việc ngắn) → chọn when
Câu 18: Thấy play the piano very ___ (tả cách chơi) → chọn well (giỏi)
Câu 19: Thấy lots of cafés and restaurants (nhiều quán) → chọn lively (nhộn nhịp)
Câu 20: Thấy it's ___ the subway (so bằng, phủ định) → chọn not as crowded as

35:all.name: Học Bá · Unit 3 · câu 21–40
35:all.text:
Câu 1. Ghazala wants to ___ the Science Museum in July.
	*A. visit
	B. sightsee
	C. go
Câu 2. I think suitcases with wheels are more ___ than suitcases without wheels.
	A. practically
	*B. practical
	C. practicaller
Câu 3. I'm really tired, so I want to sit ___ for a while.
	*A. quietly
	B. quiet
	C. more quiet
Câu 4. He took his friend to the airport this morning and then he ___ to work.
	A. was going
	*B. went
	C. go
Câu 5. Did you ___ this suitcase yourself?
	A. do
	*B. pack
	C. make
Câu 6. Who is the ___ person you know?
	A. funnyest
	B. more funny
	*C. funniest
Câu 7. Look at this ___ flower. I don't know its name.
	A. messy
	B. ugly
	*C. unusual
Câu 8. The bag broke while I ___ the groceries to the car.
	*A. was carrying
	B. carried
	C. were carrying
Câu 9. We always eat ___ when we're on vacation.
	A. a barbecue
	*B. out
	C. local attractions
Câu 10. She worked ___ all year and passed her exams.
	A. good
	B. hardly
	*C. hard
Câu 11. Our vacation this year is ___ than last year.
	A. more short
	*B. shorter
	C. shortter
Câu 12. I was really ___ on the flight to Lima because there wasn't much space for my legs.
	*A. uncomfortable
	B. quiet
	C. busy
Câu 13. "Were you sleeping when I called you at home?" "No, I ___."
	*A. wasn't
	B. weren't
	C. didn't
Câu 14. My parents went on a ___ of Madrid.
	A. sightseeing
	B. guide
	*C. guided tour
Câu 15. This is ___ room in the hotel.
	A. the less comfortable
	B. the least comfortablest
	*C. the least comfortable
Câu 16. Elma ___ before it started to rain.
	A. walked quick home
	*B. walked home quickly
	C. walking home quickly
Câu 17. Luckily, we ___ fast when the dog ran into the street.
	A. was driving
	B. didn't drive
	*C. weren't driving
Câu 18. The stores are always ___ at this time of year. Everyone is buying presents for friends and family.
	A. quiet
	*B. busy
	C. messy
Câu 19. Samuel's not as patient as ___.
	A. she
	*B. she is
	C. her is
Câu 20. Petra reserved a ___ on a train to Budapest.
	*A. seat
	B. flight
	C. visit
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy the Science Museum (nơi chốn, không có to) → chọn visit (tham quan)
Câu 2: Thấy more ___ than → chọn practical (tính từ gốc)
Câu 3: Thấy sit ___ (tả cách ngồi) → chọn quietly · tả cách làm dùng -ly
Câu 4: Thấy took ... and then (chuỗi việc đã qua) → chọn went
Câu 5: Thấy this suitcase (vali) → chọn pack (xếp đồ)
Câu 6: Thấy the ___ person (nhất) → chọn funniest · y đổi thành i + est
Câu 7: Thấy I don't know its name (không biết tên hoa) → chọn unusual (lạ)
Câu 8: Thấy while I ___ (việc dài) → chọn was carrying
Câu 9: Thấy eat ___ (ăn ngoài) → chọn out · eat out = ăn ở ngoài
Câu 10: Thấy worked ___ and passed (làm chăm nên đỗ) → chọn hard (chăm chỉ)
Câu 11: Thấy than + short (chữ ngắn) → chọn shorter
Câu 12: Thấy wasn't much space for my legs (chật chỗ để chân) → chọn uncomfortable (khó chịu)
Câu 13: Thấy câu hỏi Were you...? + trả lời bằng I → chọn wasn't
Câu 14: Thấy went on a ___ of (đi tham quan) → chọn guided tour (tour có hướng dẫn)
Câu 15: Thấy in the hotel (kém nhất cả khách sạn) → chọn the least comfortable
Câu 16: Thấy walked + home → chọn walked home quickly (động từ, nơi chốn, rồi -ly)
Câu 17: Thấy Luckily + we + when the dog ran → chọn weren't driving
Câu 18: Thấy Everyone is buying presents (ai cũng mua quà) → chọn busy (đông)
Câu 19: Thấy as patient as ___ (vế sau đủ người + động từ) → chọn she is
Câu 20: Thấy on a train (chỗ trên tàu) → chọn seat (ghế)

36:all.name: Học Bá · Unit 4 · câu 1–20
36:all.text:
Câu 1. ___ go abroad on my next vacation.
	A. Probably I won't
	*B. I probably won't
	C. I won't probably
Câu 2. My dad is a firefighter. ___ often works at night.
	*A. He
	B. She
	C. Him
Câu 3. ___ anything next weekend?
	A. Might you do
	*B. Are you doing
	C. Do you do
Câu 4. Sara's excellent at math. I think she'll be ___ when she graduates from college.
	*A. an accountant
	B. a fashion designer
	C. a journalist
Câu 5. Patricia's sick. She ___ to work tomorrow.
	A. 's not be going
	B. doesn't go
	*C. 's not going
Câu 6. I ___ a pay raise this month, so I'm going to buy a new car.
	A. won
	*B. got
	C. took
Câu 7. ___ you get a promotion this year?
	A. May
	B. Might
	*C. Will
Câu 8. The movie ___ explained his ideas to the actors.
	A. coach
	B. designer
	*C. director
Câu 9. Please print out these letters and send ___ to all the interns.
	*A. them
	B. their
	C. it
Câu 10. I'm going ___.
	A. tomorrow to watch a movie
	*B. to watch a movie tomorrow
	C. to watch tomorrow a movie
Câu 11. "New Tech Limited. How can I help you?" said the ___ when he answered the phone.
	A. firefighter
	*B. receptionist
	C. flight attendant
Câu 12. I saw the job ___ online and I knew it was the right job for me.
	*A. ad
	B. application
	C. résumé
Câu 13. Hairdressers are always on their feet all day. ___ never sit down.
	A. He
	*B. They
	C. Their
Câu 14. "Will there be any vegetarian options on the menu?" "There ___ be. I don't know."
	A. will
	*B. might
	C. probably
Câu 15. The new salesperson ___ a training course next week.
	*A. is taking
	B. is sending
	C. is working
Câu 16. We ___ at home tonight.
	A. 're going
	B. relax
	*C. 're going to relax
Câu 17. The ___ carefully carried the customers' drinks to their table.
	*A. waitress
	B. surgeon
	C. fashion designer
Câu 18. Seb has a ___ in engineering from the University of Buenos Aires.
	A. career
	*B. degree
	C. job
Câu 19. She studied all weekend. I'm sure she ___ pass the test.
	*A. will
	B. won't
	C. might
Câu 20. After college, I worked ___ an intern for a local newspaper.
	A. on
	B. in
	*C. as
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy probably + won't → probably đứng trước won't → chọn I probably won't
Câu 2: Thấy My dad (bố, nam) đứng đầu câu → chọn He
Câu 3: Thấy next weekend (hỏi kế hoạch) → chọn Are you doing
Câu 4: Thấy excellent at math (giỏi toán) → chọn an accountant (kế toán)
Câu 5: Thấy sick + tomorrow (ốm, mai đã quyết nghỉ) → chọn 's not going
Câu 6: Thấy a pay raise (tăng lương) → chọn got
Câu 7: Thấy this year + get (hỏi chuyện sắp tới) → chọn Will
Câu 8: Thấy movie + actors (chỉ đạo diễn viên) → chọn director (đạo diễn)
Câu 9: Thấy send ___ thay cho these letters (nhiều lá thư) → chọn them
Câu 10: Thấy going → chọn to watch a movie tomorrow (to + việc + cái gì + thời gian)
Câu 11: Thấy answered the phone + tên công ty → chọn receptionist (lễ tân)
Câu 12: Thấy saw ... online (thấy tin trên mạng) → chọn ad (tin tuyển dụng)
Câu 13: Thấy Hairdressers (nhiều người) → chọn They
Câu 14: Thấy I don't know (không chắc) → chọn might (có thể)
Câu 15: Thấy a training course (khóa đào tạo) → chọn is taking
Câu 16: Thấy tonight + We're going → chọn 're going to relax
Câu 17: Thấy drinks to their table (bưng đồ uống ra bàn) → chọn waitress (phục vụ)
Câu 18: Thấy University (bằng đại học) → chọn degree (bằng cấp)
Câu 19: Thấy I'm sure (chắc chắn) → chọn will
Câu 20: Thấy worked ___ an intern (làm nghề gì) → chọn as

37:all.name: Học Bá · Unit 4 · câu 21–40
37:all.text:
Câu 1. I ___ to the hairdresser's on Thursday.
	A. go
	B. going to go
	*C. 'm going
Câu 2. The news ___ tried to interview Pedro Almódovar on the red carpet.
	A. agent
	*B. reporter
	C. person
Câu 3. My sister wants to be a fashion designer. ___ clothes are beautiful.
	A. His
	*B. Her
	C. Its
Câu 4. I can't go out tonight. I'm ___ a résumé.
	*A. writing
	B. making
	C. doing
Câu 5. The ___ offered the customers a choice of three different resorts.
	A. flight attendant
	B. tour guide
	*C. travel agent
Câu 6. There'll be a storm ___. The sky is really dark.
	A. yesterday
	B. last week
	*C. tonight
Câu 7. My son ___ school next week.
	A. finishing
	B. 's finishes
	*C. 's going to finish
Câu 8. I sent my ___ form three weeks ago.

Câu 9. When you pack your suitcase, check ___ weight before you go to the airport.

Câu 10. The ___ wrote an article last week about a dishonest accountant.
	A. police officer
	B. lawyer
	*C. journalist
Câu 11. I don't think Andy ___ quit his job this year.
	A. might
	*B. will

Câu 12. What ___ over summer vacation?

	B. Sam's doing

Câu 13. They offered me the job and then we ___ on a salary.
	A. said

Câu 14. "Are you going to visit Grandma tomorrow?" "Yes, ___."
	A. I going to

Câu 15. The ___ guard stopped the woman at the door.

	A. Are you going

------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy on Thursday (lịch hẹn) → chọn 'm going
Câu 2: Thấy news + interview (phỏng vấn) → chọn reporter (phóng viên)
Câu 3: Thấy My sister (nữ) + clothes → chọn Her
Câu 4: Thấy a résumé (CV) → chọn writing · write a résumé = viết CV
Câu 5: Thấy resorts (chọn khu nghỉ trước chuyến đi) → chọn travel agent (đại lý du lịch)
Câu 6: Thấy There'll (sẽ) → chọn tonight (tương lai)
Câu 7: Thấy next week → chọn 's going to finish
Câu 8: Thấy form → chọn application · application form = đơn xin việc
Câu 9: Thấy suitcase (đồ vật) + weight → chọn its (của nó)
Câu 10: Thấy wrote an article (viết bài báo) → chọn journalist (nhà báo)
Câu 11: Thấy I don't think → chọn will (chữ "không" đã ở don't)
Câu 12: Thấy What ___ ? + Sam → chọn 's Sam going to do (is đứng trước Sam)
Câu 13: Thấy on a salary (thống nhất lương) → chọn agreed
Câu 14: Thấy câu hỏi Are you...? → chọn I am
Câu 15: Thấy guard + stopped at the door → chọn security · security guard = bảo vệ
Câu 16: Thấy She'll tell me next week (chưa chắc) → chọn may
Câu 17: Thấy for a job (xin việc) → chọn applied
Câu 18: Thấy coming (V-ing) + the ball → chọn It's (= It is)
Câu 19: Thấy at 4:15 today (giờ cụ thể hôm nay) → chọn Are you taking
Câu 20: Thấy definitely (chắc chắn) → chọn will

38:all.name: Học Bá · Unit 5 · câu 1–20
38:all.text:
Câu 1. If I have some free time later, I ___ running.
	A. go
	B. 'm going
	*C. 'll go
Câu 2. I ___ call my husband because I think I'm going to be home late.
	A. shouldn't
	*B. should
	C. don't
Câu 3. Julieta felt ___ because she was late for her son's basketball game.
	A. jealous
	*B. guilty
	C. envious
Câu 4. I'm going to relax for an hour because I am ___.
	A. a headache
	B. the flu
	*C. stressed
Câu 5. Katie passed her driving test today. Her parents are ___ proud.
	*A. extremely
	B. a little
	C. a lot
Câu 6. They went to Russia and ___ an effort to speak the language.
	*A. made
	B. did
	C. had
Câu 7. Where ___ I send the application form?
	A. will
	B. could
	*C. should
Câu 8. Lorenzo ___ his finger on the stove while he was making soup.
	A. cut
	*B. burned
	C. broke
Câu 9. I'll make an excuse if I ___ to go to the party.
	A. won't want
	*B. don't want
	C. didn't want
Câu 10. It's difficult to be ___ when you're late and the traffic is bad.
	*A. calm
	B. stressed
	C. nervous
Câu 11. When you're giving a presentation, ___ a deep breath and try to relax before you start.
	*A. take
	B. make
	C. have
Câu 12. Why don't you ___ today? You look tired.
	*A. take a nap
	B. have nap
	C. take nap
Câu 13. "How can I help you, Mrs. Romero?" "I ___."
	A. 'm feeling earache
	*B. have an earache
	C. 'm hurting my ear
Câu 14. She's ___ happy because she didn't get the job.
	A. very
	B. a little
	*C. not very
Câu 15. ___ to work if it's sunny tomorrow?
	A. Do you walk
	B. Walk you
	*C. Will you walk
Câu 16. Grace thanked Deepti and gave her some flowers. Deepti was ___.
	*A. delighted
	B. cheerful
	C. confident
Câu 17. How many mistakes did you ___ on the test?
	*A. make
	B. do
	C. have
Câu 18. Camilo doesn't think ___ leave your job.
	A. you shouldn't
	*B. you should
	C. should you
Câu 19. I was very sick yesterday. I still have a cold, but I feel ___ better today.
	A. very

	*C. a little

	*A. the flu
	B. stress
	C. a cough
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy If I have (hiện tại) → vế sau chọn 'll go (will)
Câu 2: Thấy I'm going to be home late (sẽ về muộn) → chọn should (nên gọi báo)
Câu 3: Thấy was late (mình đến muộn) → chọn guilty (thấy có lỗi)
Câu 4: Thấy I am + cần nghỉ ngơi → chọn stressed (căng thẳng)
Câu 5: Thấy passed her driving test (đỗ lái xe) + proud → chọn extremely (cực kỳ)
Câu 6: Thấy an effort → chọn made · make an effort = cố gắng
Câu 7: Thấy Where ___ I send? (hỏi xin chỉ dẫn) → chọn should
Câu 8: Thấy on the stove (bếp nóng) → chọn burned (bị bỏng)
Câu 9: Thấy if I ___ (vế if) → chọn don't want (hiện tại, không dùng will)
Câu 10: Thấy It's difficult to be + late + bad traffic → chọn calm (khó giữ bình tĩnh)
Câu 11: Thấy a deep breath → chọn take · take a deep breath = hít thở sâu
Câu 12: Thấy You look tired (trông mệt) → chọn take a nap (chợp mắt, đủ take + a)
Câu 13: Thấy I ___ + đau tai → chọn have an earache · bị đau dùng have
Câu 14: Thấy didn't get the job (không được nhận) → chọn not very (không vui lắm)
Câu 15: Thấy if it's sunny tomorrow → chọn Will you walk
Câu 16: Thấy thanked + gave her some flowers (được cảm ơn, tặng hoa) → chọn delighted (rất vui)
Câu 17: Thấy mistakes → chọn make · make a mistake = mắc lỗi
Câu 18: Thấy doesn't think → chọn you should (chữ "không" đã ở doesn't)
Câu 19: Thấy better (so sánh hơn) → chọn a little (không dùng very)
Câu 20: Thấy sốt + đau đầu + đau họng → chọn the flu (cúm)

39:all.name: Học Bá · Unit 5 · câu 21–40
39:all.text:
Câu 1. If they ___ me the job, I'll make the decision today.

	*B. offer

	*A. make

	C. do
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy If they ___ (vế if) → chọn offer (hiện tại, they không thêm s)
Câu 2: Thấy some coffee (uống cà phê) → chọn have

Câu 6: Thấy I think (khuyên) → chọn you should (không có to)

Câu 16: Thấy câu hỏi Should I...? → chọn you should (dừng ở should)
Câu 17: Thấy terrible (kỳ nghỉ tệ) + with my brother → chọn an argument (cãi nhau)
Câu 18: Thấy If you want..., ___ confident (lời khuyên) → chọn be
Câu 19: Thấy a headache all day (đau đầu cả ngày) → chọn miserable (khổ sở)
Câu 20: Thấy a list → chọn make · make a list = lập danh sách

40:all.name: Học Bá · Unit 6 · câu 1–20

Câu 6. We climbed to the top of some ___ yesterday. I felt nervous because they were very high.
	A. roots
	*B. cliffs
	C. valleys
Câu 7. I've been hiking. I've tried surfing and rock climbing, ___.
	A. then
	B. and
	*C. too
Câu 8. Jonathan has ___ running now. He prefers hiking these days.
	A. given back
	*B. given up
	C. filled up
Câu 9. Paraguay, Austria, ___ Bolivia are countries without a coast.
	*A. and
	B. as well
	C. too
Câu 10. Can you see that beautiful bird? Look! It's on that ___.
	A. peak
	B. lightning
	*C. branch
Câu 11. We've ___ of coffee. Will you buy some, please?
	*A. run out
	B. taken up
	C. thrown away
Câu 12. If I ___ do Pilates every week, I would have a backache.
	A. wouldn't
	*B. didn't
	C. don't
Câu 13. We've traveled around the country ___.
	*A. many times
	B. two years ago
	C. in 2016
Câu 14. I'll answer the phone. You ___ cooking.
	A. turn on
	*B. go on
	C. turn into
Câu 15. While we were on vacation, we went sightseeing. We visited some museums ___.
	A. then
	B. also
	*C. as well
Câu 16. We couldn't go to the park yesterday. There was a thunderstorm and some ___.
	A. waterfall
	B. peak
	*C. lightning
Câu 17. Take your time when you ___ the application form for your passport. You don't want to make a mistake.
	*A. fill out
	B. fill up
	C. take up
Câu 18. We aren't going swimming today because there are a lot of ___.
	*A. waves
	B. ocean
	C. streams
Câu 19. Have you ever ___ a kangaroo?
	A. see
	*B. seen
	C. saw
Câu 20. If you could live in any country in the world, where ___ live?
	*A. would you
	B. will you
	C. you would
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy I'd buy ... if → chọn I were · If I were you = nếu tôi là bạn
Câu 2: Thấy washed the car + take a break (rửa xe xong, nghỉ, rồi dọn) → chọn clean up
Câu 3: Thấy three years ago → chọn went
Câu 4: Thấy our cat + while we're on vacation (trông mèo khi đi vắng) → chọn take care of
Câu 5: Thấy has never + to Europe → chọn been · been to = từng đến
Câu 6: Thấy top + very high (đỉnh rất cao) → chọn cliffs (vách đá)
Câu 7: Thấy cuối câu, thêm ý "cũng" → chọn too
Câu 8: Thấy prefers hiking these days (giờ thích môn khác) → chọn given up (bỏ)
Câu 9: Thấy A, B, ___ C (liệt kê) → chọn and
Câu 10: Thấy bird + on that (chim đậu trên) → chọn branch (cành cây)
Câu 11: Thấy of coffee + buy some (hết cà phê, mua thêm) → chọn run out
Câu 12: Thấy would ở vế sau → chọn didn't
Câu 13: Thấy We've traveled → chọn many times (số lần)
Câu 14: Thấy I'll answer the phone. You ___ cooking (bạn cứ nấu tiếp) → chọn go on
Câu 15: Thấy cuối câu, thêm ý "cũng" → chọn as well
Câu 16: Thấy thunderstorm (giông) → chọn lightning (sét)
Câu 17: Thấy the application form (tờ đơn) → chọn fill out (điền)
Câu 18: Thấy aren't going swimming (không đi bơi vì biển) → chọn waves (sóng)
Câu 19: Thấy Have you ever → chọn seen (V3 của see)
Câu 20: Thấy If you could → chọn would you

41:all.name: Học Bá · Unit 6 · câu 21–40
41:all.text:
Câu 1. Don't ___ the newspaper. I'm going to read it later.
	*A. throw away
	B. look up
	C. hold on
Câu 2. Yesterday, we visited some of the local attractions and ___ saw a lot of wildlife.
	A. as well
	*B. also
	C. too
Câu 3. Anna's car ___ while she was driving to work.
	A. took up
	*B. broke down
	C. ran out of
Câu 4. You can take a boat on the river through the ___.
	A. branch
	B. cliff
	*C. valley
Câu 5. I ___ nervous if I was going for an interview tomorrow.
	*A. 'd be
	B. was
	C. be
Câu 6. I love ___, but I wouldn't want to see a bear!
	*A. wildlife
	B. roots
	C. waves
Câu 7. Can you ___ what time their flight arrives?
	A. take care of
	B. take up
	*C. find out
Câu 8. I ___ a vacation in the mountains.
	A. haven't never had
	B. ever had
	*C. 've never had
Câu 9. We would get more exercise if we ___ time.
	A. would have
	*B. had
	C. have
Câu 10. There was a ___ while we were hiking. We were cold and miserable.
	*A. thunderstorm
	B. shore
	C. peak
Câu 11. Alexandra ___ parachuting, but she usually likes adventure sports.
	A. has try
	B. not tried
	*C. has never tried
Câu 12. A ___ isn't as big as a river.
	*A. stream
	B. shore
	C. lake
Câu 13. I didn't understand the word, so I ___ in a dictionary.
	A. looked it at
	*B. looked it up
	C. looked it
Câu 14. The ocean was calm, but we didn't go swimming because there were a lot of ___.
	A. waves
	B. roots
	*C. rocks
Câu 15. The ___ was amazing this morning. The sky turned really pink.
	*A. sunrise
	B. rainforest
	C. sunset
Câu 16. If you went to the gym this morning, you ___ a nap later.
	A. could took
	B. can take
	*C. could take
Câu 17. Rio de Janeiro is famous for the beaches on its ___.
	*A. coast
	B. waves
	C. mountains
Câu 18. Your camera isn't broken. You haven't ___!
	A. turned it into
	*B. turned it on
	C. filled it out
Câu 19. Please turn off the radio! I ___ this song three times today and I hate it.
	A. 'm hearing
	B. hear
	*C. 've heard
Câu 20. He's really angry because she hasn't ___ the money.
	*A. given back
	B. given up
	C. taken up
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy read it later (còn đọc sau, đừng vứt) → chọn throw away
Câu 2: Thấy giữa câu, trước động từ saw → chọn also
Câu 3: Thấy car + while she was driving (xe hỏng giữa đường) → chọn broke down
Câu 4: Thấy river through the (sông chảy qua) → chọn valley (thung lũng)
Câu 5: Thấy if I was going (quá khứ) → chọn 'd be (would be)
Câu 6: Thấy a bear (con gấu) → chọn wildlife (động vật hoang dã)
Câu 7: Thấy what time (muốn biết mấy giờ) → chọn find out (tìm hiểu)
Câu 8: Thấy never + a vacation → chọn 've never had (không thêm not)
Câu 9: Thấy would ở vế trước → chọn had
Câu 10: Thấy cold and miserable (lạnh, khổ) → chọn thunderstorm (giông)
Câu 11: Thấy but she usually likes (ý ngược) → chọn has never tried
Câu 12: Thấy isn't as big as a river (nhỏ hơn sông) → chọn stream (suối)
Câu 13: Thấy in a dictionary (tra từ điển) → chọn looked it up
Câu 14: Thấy The ocean was calm (biển lặng, không có sóng) → chọn rocks (đá)
Câu 15: Thấy this morning + sky pink → chọn sunrise (bình minh)
Câu 16: Thấy If you went (quá khứ) → chọn could take
Câu 17: Thấy beaches (bãi biển) → chọn coast (bờ biển)
Câu 18: Thấy camera isn't broken (không hỏng, chỉ chưa bật) → chọn turned it on
Câu 19: Thấy three times today (đếm số lần) → chọn 've heard
Câu 20: Thấy angry + the money (chưa trả tiền) → chọn given back

28:1-25.name: Học Bá · Biến đổi câu của cô · câu 1–25
28:1-25.text:
Câu 1. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: Tom doesn’t work as hard as his brother.
	*A. His brother works harder than Tom.
	B. His brother works as hard as Tom.
	C. His brother works the hardest.
	D. His brother works more hard as Tom.
Câu 2. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: I think you should talk to your teacher.
	A. If I were you, I will talk to my teacher.
	B. If I were you, I talked to my teacher.
	*C. If I were you, I would talk to my teacher.
	D. If I were you, I talk to my teacher.
Câu 3. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: This is the first time she has visited Japan.
	A. She has never visit Japan before.
	*B. She has never visited Japan before.
	C. She has never been Japan before.
	D. She has never been visiting Japan before.
Câu 4. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: I’m very tired, so I can’t finish the report.
	A. If I am not tired, I would finish the report.
	*B. If I weren’t tired, I would finish the report.
	C. If I wouldn’t be tired, I would finish the report.
	D. If I haven’t been tired, I would finish the report.
Câu 5. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: He started working at the company in 2010.
	A. He has worked here for 2010.
	B. He has been working here since 2010.
	*C. He has worked here since 2010.
	D. He has been here from 2010.
Câu 6. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: She used to eat meat.
	*A. She doesn’t eat meat now.
	B. She didn’t eat meat now.
	C. She don’t eat meat now.
	D. She isn’t eating meat now.
Câu 7. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: We stayed home because the rain was heavy.
	A. We stayed home because of the heavily rain.
	*B. We stayed home because of the heavy rain.
	C. We stayed home because of the heavier rain.
	D. We stayed home because of the heaviness
Câu 8. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: He was sick, but he went to work.
	A. He went to work even though he is sick.
	B. He went to work even though he be sick.
	*C. He went to work even though he was sick.
	D. He went to work even though he were sick.
Câu 9. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: She visited Paris with the idea of learning French.
	A. She visited Paris learning French.
	B. She visited Paris for learning French.
	*C. She visited Paris to learn French.
	D. She visited Paris with learning French.
Câu 10. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: It is a good idea to check your answers.
	A. You may check your answers.
	*B. You should check your answers.
	C. You must check your answers.
	D. You can check your answers.
Câu 11. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: I think we will start early.
	*A. We should start early.
	B. We will start early.
	C. We can start early.
	D. We might start early.
Câu 12. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: We use this knife to cut vegetables.
	*A. This knife is for cutting vegetables.
	B. This knife is for cut vegetables.
	C. This knife is to cut vegetables.
	D. This knife is cuts vegetables.
Câu 13. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: It’s unnecessary to bring your own drink.
	A. You mustn’t bring your own drink.
	*B. You don’t have to bring your own drink.
	C. You shouldn’t bring your own drink.
	D. You can’t bring your own drink.
Câu 14. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: What are you going to wear tonight?
	A. What do you wear tonight?
	*B. What are you wearing tonight?
	C. What will you wear tonight?
	D. What have you worn tonight?
Câu 15. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: She studies hard to get good marks.
	A. In order to get good marks, she study hard.
	*B. In order to get good marks, she studies hard.
	C. In order to get good marks, she studied hard.
	D. In order to get good marks, she studying hard.
Câu 16. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: The suitcase was too heavy to lift.
	A. The suitcase was so heavy that I can’t lift it.
	*B. The suitcase was so heavy that I couldn’t lift it.
	C. The suitcase was so heavy that I didn’t lift it.
	D. The suitcase was so heavy that I haven’t lifted it.
Câu 17. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: I used to live in Hanoi.
	*A. I don’t live in Hanoi now.
	B. I didn’t live in Hanoi now.
	C. I not live in Hanoi now.
	D. I no live in Hanoi now.
Câu 18. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: Students cannot enter this room.
	A. Students are allowing to enter this room.
	B. Students are allowed to enter this room.
	*C. Students are not allowed to enter this room.
	D. Students allow to enter this room.
Câu 19. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: I would rather rest than study.
	*A. I dislike studying.
	B. I dislikes studying.
	C. I dislike to study.
	D. I dislike study.
Câu 20. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: The boy was noisy while he played.
	A. The boy played noise.
	B. The boy played noisy.
	*C. The boy played noisily.
	D. The boy played more noisy.
Câu 21. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: She is the most talented singer here.
	A. No one here is talented as she is.
	*B. No one here is more talented than she is.
	C. No one here is as talented.
	D. No one here is talented than she is.
Câu 22. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: He talks too much, and people get bored.
	*A. The more he talks, the more bored people get.
	B. The more he talks, the more boring people get.
	C. The more he talks, the more bore people get.
	D. The more he talks, the more boringly people get.
Câu 23. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: The lesson is difficult to understand.
	A. It is difficult to understanding the lesson.
	*B. It is difficult to understand the lesson.
	C. It is difficult to understands the lesson.
	D. It is difficult to understood the lesson.
Câu 24. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: She was sorry when she heard the news.
	A. She was sorry hearing the news.
	*B. She was sorry to hear the news.
	C. She was sorry hear the news.
	D. She was sorry heard the news.
Câu 25. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: He has little experience.
	A. He doesn’t have many experience.
	*B. He doesn’t have much experience.
	C. He doesn’t have few experience.
	D. He doesn’t have a few experience.
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy doesn't ... as hard as → tìm chữ harder than
Câu 2: Thấy should → tìm chữ would
Câu 3: Thấy the first time → tìm chữ never visited
Câu 4: Thấy tired, so I can't → tìm chữ weren't
Câu 5: Thấy started ... in 2010 → tìm câu có has worked + since
Câu 6: Thấy used to → tìm chữ doesn't
Câu 7: Thấy because the rain was heavy → tìm chữ heavy rain
Câu 8: Thấy was sick, but → tìm chữ was sick
Câu 9: Thấy with the idea of learning → tìm chữ to learn
Câu 10: Thấy a good idea to → tìm chữ should
Câu 11: Thấy I think ... will → tìm chữ should
Câu 12: Thấy use ... to cut → tìm chữ for cutting
Câu 13: Thấy unnecessary → tìm chữ don't have to
Câu 14: Thấy are you going to wear → tìm chữ are you wearing
Câu 15: Thấy studies hard to get → tìm chữ she studies
Câu 16: Thấy too heavy to lift → tìm chữ couldn't
Câu 17: Thấy used to live → tìm chữ don't live
Câu 18: Thấy cannot enter → tìm chữ not allowed
Câu 19: Thấy would rather rest than study → tìm chữ I dislike studying
Câu 20: Thấy noisy while he played → tìm chữ noisily
Câu 21: Thấy the most → tìm câu có more + than
Câu 22: Thấy talks too much ... bored → tìm chữ more bored
Câu 23: Thấy difficult to understand → tìm chữ understand the
Câu 24: Thấy sorry when she heard → tìm chữ to hear
Câu 25: Thấy little → tìm chữ much

28:26-36.name: Học Bá · Biến đổi câu của cô · câu 26–36
28:26-36.text:
Câu 1. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: We were late because the traffic was bad.
	A. We were late because of the badly traffic.
	*B. We were late because of the bad traffic.
	C. We were late because of the worse traffic.
	D. We were late because of the badly of traffic.
Câu 2. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: Prices will increase soon.
	A. Prices are likely increase soon.
	*B. Prices are likely to increase soon.
	C. Prices are likely increasing soon.
	D. Prices are likely to increasing soon.
Câu 3. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: He used to play soccer.
	*A. Now he doesn’t play soccer.
	B. Now he don’t play soccer.
	C. Now he didn’t play soccer.
	D. Now he isn’t playing soccer.
Câu 4. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: Too much caffeine may cause insomnia.
	A. Too much caffeine may leading insomnia.
	B. Too much caffeine may lead insomnia.
	*C. Too much caffeine may lead to insomnia.
	D. Too much caffeine may to lead insomnia.
Câu 5. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: She won’t succeed if she doesn’t try.
	A. She cannot succeed with trying.
	*B. She cannot succeed without trying.
	C. She cannot succeed unless trying.
	D. She cannot succeed despite trying.
Câu 6. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: They sell unusual clothes.
	A. Their clothes are different with others.
	B. Their clothes are different than others.
	*C. Their clothes are different from others.
	D. Their clothes are different at others.
Câu 7. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: Although she practiced a lot, she didn’t win.
	A. Despite practice a lot, she didn’t win.
	B. Despite practiced a lot, she didn’t win.
	*C. Despite practicing a lot, she didn’t win.
	D. Despite to practice a lot, she didn’t win.
Câu 8. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: They repaired the car yesterday.
	*A. The car was repaired yesterday.
	B. The car is repaired yesterday.
	C. The car repairs yesterday.
	D. The car repaired yesterday.
Câu 9. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: He needs to sleep more.
	A. It is necessary for him sleep more.
	*B. It is necessary for him to sleep more.
	C. It is necessary for him sleeping more.
	D. It is necessary for him slept more.
Câu 10. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: They were dancing when the music stopped.
	A. The music stopped when they were dancing.
	B. The music stopped because they were dancing.
	*C. The music stopped while they were dancing.
	D. The music stopped after they were dancing.
Câu 11. Chọn câu có nghĩa giống câu gốc nhất: My bike is not as expensive as yours.
	*A. Your bike is more expensive than mine.
	B. Your bike is expensive than mine.
	C. Your bike is the most expensive than mine.
	D. Your bike is as expensive as mine.
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy because the traffic was bad → tìm chữ the bad traffic
Câu 2: Thấy will increase → tìm chữ likely to increase
Câu 3: Thấy used to play → tìm chữ doesn't
Câu 4: Thấy cause → tìm chữ lead to
Câu 5: Thấy won't ... if she doesn't try → tìm chữ without
Câu 6: Thấy unusual → tìm chữ different from
Câu 7: Thấy Although → tìm chữ Despite practicing
Câu 8: Thấy They repaired → tìm chữ was repaired
Câu 9: Thấy needs to → tìm chữ for him to
Câu 10: Thấy were dancing when → tìm chữ while
Câu 11: Thấy not as expensive as yours → tìm chữ more expensive

24:all.name: Học Bá · Điền từ I: Living in the city
24:all.text:
Câu 1. Living in the city is an experience that everyone should try at _____ once in their life.
	A. most
	B. more
	C. less
	*D. least
Câu 2. I have been living in Ho Chi Minh City for two years now and I have _____ seen many changes.
	*A. already
	B. soon
	C. yet
	D. ever
Câu 3. The city has grown so much that it is hard to _____ up with all the new developments.
	A. put
	*B. keep
	C. give
	D. take
Câu 4. I have yet to see everything that this city has to _____.
	*A. offer
	B. move
	C. take
	D. consider
Câu 5. Everything is _____ walking distance or a short drive away.
	A. in
	B. on
	C. along
	*D. within
Câu 6. There are many shops, restaurants, and entertainment _____ to choose from.
	A. palaces
	B. monuments
	C. towers
	*D. venues
Câu 7. However, there are also some _____ to living in the city.
	A. advantages
	*B. downsides
	C. benefits
	D. purposes
Câu 8. The traffic can be terrible during _____ hour and it can take hours to get anywhere.
	A. high
	B. busy
	C. push
	*D. rush
Câu 9. Pollution is also a problem, especially during the dry season when the air _____ is at (10) ___ worst.
	A. conditioning
	B. level
	*C. quality
	D. weather
Câu 10. Pollution is also a problem, especially during the dry season when the air (9) ___ is at _____ worst.
	A. it
	*B. its
	C. it’s
	D. is
Câu 11. Another problem is the _____ of green spaces.
	*A. lack
	B. availability
	C. number
	D. abundance
Câu 12. If you want to go for a walk or run, it often involves navigating through _____ streets or crowded areas.
	A. quiet
	*B. narrow
	C. dark
	D. crowded
Câu 13. The lack of quiet spaces can also lead to _____ stress for those who need a break from the noise.
	A. reduced
	*B. increased
	C. eliminated
	D. diminished
Câu 14. On the other hand, living in the city provides easy access to _____ job opportunities.
	*A. more
	B. better
	C. limited
	D. few
Câu 15. Many businesses are located in the heart of the city, meaning that career-driven individuals can grow their _____ faster.
	A. knowledge
	*B. career
	C. money
	D. friends
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy at ___ once (ít nhất một lần) → chọn least · at least = ít nhất

20:all.name: Học Bá · Đọc: The Giant Panda (Reading 4)
20:all.text:
Phần 1. Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi
The giant panda is a bear that lives in central China. It is special because of its black and white fur. Pandas belong to the most endangered species of our world. About 2000 pandas live in the wilderness and 300 live in various zoos around the world. Recently, there have been campaigns in many countries to save the giant panda. The animal has been driven away from its natural habitat because of deforestation, intensive farming and the creation of new settlements. The giant panda can reach a height of up to 1.5 metres and weigh up to 150 kg. Pandas have bodies like bears, but scientists do not know why they grow a thick, black and white fur. It keeps them warm during the cold winter months and the white colour protects them from possible enemies in the snow-covered mountains in which they live. Pandas have large teeth, which they need to eat bamboo, their basic food. Because it is low in nutritional value it does not give pandas much energy to move around for longer periods of time. Giant pandas can live up to 20 years in the wilderness and 30 years in zoos. They start reproducing between 4 and 8 years of age. When “panda cubs” are born, they are very tiny, only about a thousandth the size of the mother, and blind. Like all mammals, they get their food from their mother, whom they stay with for up to three years before being able to survive alone. Pandas have been an important species throughout history. They first became known in the western world during the middle of the 19th century. In the 1960s, the Chinese government realised it had to do something to protect the giant pandas from becoming extinct. Since then, they have set up 40 reserves in which the animals are protected. In the 1970s, pandas played a role in the opening of Communist China to the west. They were sold to zoos in other countries. Today, about 45 pandas live in zoos outside China. Zoologists are putting millions of dollars into breeding the animals in captivity. When they get older, they are released again into their natural habitat.
Câu 1. What is the basic food of giant pandas?
	A. Snow-covered plants
	*B. Bamboo
	C. Meat
	D. Leaves from trees
Câu 2. Why do pandas not move around a lot?
	A. Because they live in cold mountains
	B. Because their teeth are too large
	*C. Because bamboo does not give them much energy
	D. Because they are kept in zoos most of the time
Câu 3. According to the first paragraph, why are giant pandas special?
	A. Because they are most endangered.
	B. Because their habitat is in central China.
	*C. Because they have two-coloured fur.
	D. Because they live in both wilderness and zoos.
Câu 4. These are the reasons for taking pandas away from their natural habitat, except for:
	A. Deforestation
	*B. Campaigns
	C. Intensive farming
	D. New settlements
Câu 5. What action has the Chinese government taken to protect pandas?
	A. Selling pandas to other countries
	B. Creating new habitats in cities
	*C. Setting up reserves
	D. Growing bamboo for zoos
Câu 6. Which feature helps pandas survive during winter months?
	A. Their large teeth.
	B. Their height and weight.
	C. Their bear-like bodies.
	*D. Their thick, black and white fur.
Câu 7. The word “panda cubs” in paragraph 4 means:
	*A. Baby pandas.
	B. Pandas that can reproduce.
	C. Tiny and blind pandas.
	D. Pandas that can’t survive alone.
Câu 8. How did pandas play a role in the opening of the Chinese government to the west in the 19th century?
	A. They became known in the western world.
	*B. They were transferred to zoos in western countries.
	C. They were protected from being extinct in reserves.
	D. They lived in zoos outside China.
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Đoạn 3: "to eat bamboo, their basic food" → tre.
Câu 2: Đoạn 3: tre ít dinh dưỡng nên does not give pandas much energy to move around.
Câu 3: Đoạn 1: "It is special because of its black and white fur" → lông 2 màu.
Câu 4: Câu hỏi EXCEPT: 3 lý do có trong bài là phá rừng, làm nông, khu dân cư. Campaigns là chiến dịch cứu gấu trúc.
Câu 5: Đoạn 5: "they have set up 40 reserves" → lập khu bảo tồn.
Câu 6: Đoạn 3: bộ lông dày "keeps them warm during the cold winter months".
Câu 7: cub = con non của thú. "When panda cubs are born" → mới sinh → gấu trúc con.
Câu 8: Đoạn 5: "pandas played a role in the opening… They were sold to zoos in other countries" → B.

21:all.name: Học Bá · Đọc 1: Do colours affect feelings?
21:all.text:
Phần 1. Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi
Research suggests that different colours have an effect on our bodies and our emotions. Let’s find out how certain colours can change the way we feel. Blue is usually seen as a calm colour, maybe because it reminds us of the sky and the ocean. It has been shown to lower our body temperature and our heart rate, so it’s a great colour to wear when you’re just trying to relax at home. Pink is another colour which relaxes people. In some stadiums, like the Kinnick Stadium in Iowa, the dressing room for the visiting college football team is painted pink. Pink isn’t an aggressive colour, so maybe it gives the home team a psychological advantage and a better chance of winning! Many people see yellow as a cheerful colour. It’s a colour that we notice, too. That’s why yellow is often used on signs and in ads. However, sometimes yellow can make us feel annoyed or impatient. Fashion designers know that wearing certain clothes can change our feelings. One of the designers who we interviewed said, “On a rainy day, make an effort to wear a bright colour and you’ll feel much better!” Red is a very stylish colour, while orange is a little more casual. And blue? You should also wear blue when you go for a job interview because this colour makes people feel they can trust you.
Câu 1. What is the main idea of the passage?
	A. Different colours affect people in the same way.
	*B. Colours have an influence on our emotions and behavior.
	C. Bright colours are better than dark colours.
	D. Designers use colours mainly for decoration.
Câu 2. Why does the writer recommend wearing blue at home?
	A. Because it reminds people of the sky and the sea.
	B. Because it affects people’s heart rate.
	C. Because it reduces body temperature.
	*D. Because it has been shown to help people relax.
Câu 3. How might the home team of Kinnick Stadium benefit from their pink painted dressing room?
	A. It relaxes all the players from both teams.
	*B. It makes the visitors feel less motivated.
	C. It is a psychological advantage for their opponents.
	D. It makes their opponents aggressive.
Câu 4. What did the writer say about yellow?
	A. It is always a cheerful colour.
	B. People usually notice yellow signs and ads.
	*C. It irritates people sometimes.
	D. It makes people impatient very often.
Câu 5. Why is blue considered a good colour for job interviews?
	A. It helps people feel more relaxed and stylish.
	B. It makes people feel calm and sleepy.
	*C. It gives the impression that the person is reliable.
	D. It helps the interviewee remember important facts.
Câu 6. What did the designer mentioned in paragraph 5 recommend?
	*A. Wearing bright colours on rainy days can improve mood.
	B. It takes much effort to feel better on rainy days.
	C. Wearing red can make people more stylish than orange.
	D. Both red and orange should be worn on rainy days.
Câu 7. How could wearing a certain colour be beneficial in an interview?
	A. It helps candidates be more fashionable and confident.
	B. It is capable of changing people’s feelings.
	*C. It convinces employers that the interviewee is trustworthy.
	D. It is not so formal and makes the attendees feel better.
Câu 8. What is implied about red and orange in fashion?
	A. Both are suitable for formal occasions.
	B. Orange is more elegant than red.
	*C. Red is seen as more fashionable than orange.
	D. Neither red nor orange is recommended for rainy days.
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Câu đầu bài: màu sắc có ảnh hưởng đến cơ thể và cảm xúc → B.
Câu 2: Đoạn 2: "a great colour to wear when you’re just trying to relax at home" → D.
Câu 3: Phòng hồng là của đội khách. Hồng làm thư giãn, không hung hăng → đội khách bớt hăng → đội nhà có lợi.
Câu 4: Đoạn 4: "sometimes yellow can make us feel annoyed" → annoyed = irritated → C.
Câu 5: Đoạn 5: "makes people feel they can trust you" → trust = reliable (đáng tin).
Câu 6: "On a rainy day, … wear a bright colour and you’ll feel much better" → A.
Câu 7: Giống câu 5: màu xanh làm người ta thấy can trust you → trustworthy.
Câu 8: "Red is a very stylish colour, while orange is a little more casual" → đỏ thời trang hơn.

22:all.name: Học Bá · Đọc 2: Smoking costs
22:all.text:
Phần 1. Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi
The diseases connected to smoking are a big problem. Doctors think that the annual medical cost for lung cancer, heart disease, and other illnesses connected to smoking is between 12 and 35 million pounds. And smoking costs society money in other ways. Between 27 and 61 billion pounds are spent each year on sick days when people don't go to work, on wages that you don't get when you don't go to work, and on work lost at the company when you are sick. This money counts the wages from people who die of cancer at young age and stop paying taxes. This does not count fire started by cigarettes, which kill fifteen hundred people yearly and injure another four thousand. Smoking costs every man, woman and child in the UK from one hundred and ten to two hundred and fifty pounds each year in the lost work and wages. When you add another fifty to one hundred and fifty pounds yearly in insurance cost, that comes to one hundred and sixty to four hundred and ten pounds. If everyone stopped smoking, a family of four could have up to one thousand six hundred and forty pounds a year more. Smoking will also cause other problems. People who don't smoke will live longer, and so they will take money from the government when they are old. But they will also work for more years and pay more taxes. In the end, the value of a non-smoking nation is not in pounds. The good health of the people is the true value for us all.
Câu 1. If everyone stopped smoking, all the United Kingdom ______.
	A. would live longer
	B. would have less money
	C. would have no more problems
	*D. would have more money
Câu 2. Every year companies lose ______ because of the disease.
	A. wages
	B. money
	C. time
	*D. work
Câu 3. If everyone stopped smoking, a family of four could have ______ more each year.
	A. from 160 pounds to 410 pounds
	B. from 1,340 to 1,430 pounds
	C. from 110 pounds to 260 pounds
	*D. 1,640 pounds
Câu 4. The true value for the UK of not smoking is ______.
	A. more taxes
	B. more working
	C. more money
	*D. good health
Câu 5. This text is about ______.
	A. taxes which are not paid by smokers
	*B. how much smoking costs the UK
	C. how much the UK get if everyone stopped smoking
	D. diseases that smokers get
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Cả bài nói hút thuốc làm tốn tiền; bỏ thuốc thì gia đình có thêm tiền (up to 1,640 pounds more) → D.
Câu 2: Đoạn 2: "work lost at the company when you are sick" → công ty mất work.
Câu 3: "a family of four could have up to one thousand six hundred and forty pounds" = 1,640.
Câu 4: Câu cuối: "The good health of the people is the true value" → D.
Câu 5: Hầu hết bài kể các khoản chi phí do hút thuốc → B.

23:all.name: Học Bá · Đọc 3: Dear Angela
23:all.text:
Phần 1. Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi
Dear Angela, I was horrified when I found out that my 12-year-old daughter had been arrested for stealing some make-up from a high street chemist’s. This happened because she had been dared by some older children from her school. She was so frightened that she started crying – which is what attracted the attention of the shop assistant. The police were called and she was given a telling-off at the police station. Since this terrifying experience, she has been too afraid to go out on her own and cries all the time. My husband doesn’t seem to care that much. He says that she shouldn’t have stolen in the first place and was unlucky to be caught. Now it is over she must learn to live with it. But I feel a failure as a parent and am afraid that my child will turn to crime later on in life. Yours sincerely, Ashamed
Câu 1. Why has Ashamed written this letter?

	B. to prove how naughty her daughter is
	*C. to explain a problem
	D. to defend her daughter’s actions
Câu 2. Who do you think Angela is?

	B. her daughter
	C. her old boyfriend
	*D. an advice column in a magazine

	*B. Her schoolmates urged her to do so.
	C. She was attracted by the make-up.
	D. She wanted to wear make-up.
Câu 4. How did Ashamed’s daughter feel afterwards?
	*A. She was frightened.
	B. She was angry.
	C. She wanted to turn to crime.
	D. She felt she was unlucky.
Câu 5. What is the husband’s attitude towards this incident?
	A. He is cold.
	*B. He is not worried.
	C. He is terrified.
	D. He thinks she should learn to steal.
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thư gửi chuyên mục tư vấn: người mẹ kể vấn đề của mình để xin lời khuyên → C.
Câu 2: Thư bắt đầu "Dear Angela", ký tên giấu mặt "Ashamed" để kể chuyện riêng → kiểu thư gửi chuyên mục tư vấn.
Câu 3: "she had been dared by some older children from her school" → dared = thách, xúi → urged.
Câu 4: "she has been too afraid to go out… and cries all the time" → sợ hãi.
Câu 5: "My husband doesn’t seem to care that much" → không lo lắng nhiều.

Phần 1. Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi
If you're looking for somewhere exciting to visit, why not try the Bay of Fundy? Fundy is on the Atlantic coast of North America, between New Brunswick and Nova Scotia in Canada. The Fundy National Park opened in 1948 and it protects about 130 kilometers of coastline. The scenery in this area is extremely beautiful, with incredible cliffs, caves, and beaches. The Bay of Fundy is famous for its tides – the way the seawater in the bay rises and falls each day. The waves here can make the seawater rise up to sixteen meters in six hours. The tides here are much higher than those along the rest of the Atlantic coast. The Fundy National Park offers lots of activities to keep visitors busy. The bay has a large population of whales and dolphins, so it's a great place to watch these beautiful animals. Visitors can also play golf or tennis, try water sports like kayaking, or go hiking in beautiful hills, forests, and valleys. You could also explore the national park by car. There are some great towns and attractions along the Fundy Coastal Drive and you definitely won't have to worry about traffic jams! One place everyone should visit is Hopewell Rocks. These huge rocks have been here for millions of years and, over time, the wind and the ocean have changed their shape. In fact, this effect is still happening today: in 2016, one of the biggest rocks broke in half, damaging a walking path and changing the landscape. You can learn more about the rocks and the natural history of the area at the visitor's center, or go on a tour with one of our expert guides. According to local stories, the rocks were once men, and angry whales turned them into stone! If you are interested in birds, August is the best time to visit Fundy. During this month, thousands of birds stop here on their journey south for the winter. In early August, visitors can also enjoy the St. Stephen's Chocolate Festival – if you love chocolate, this is the festival for you!

62:all.name: Học Bá · Đề ôn sát đề · 6. Đọc: Cool or crazy
62:all.text:
Phần 1. Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi
The idea of speeding down the side of a volcano, while clinging with all your strength to a little piece of wood, might strike most of us as terrifying. But some people travel thousands of miles to do just that. Every year, huge groups of thrill-seekers travel to western Nicaragua's Cerro Negro mountain to take part in the new extreme sport of volcano boarding. Participants, dressed from head to foot in protective clothing, reach speeds of 80 km per hour on their specially adapted surfboards. They hike up one side of the volcano, take a training class, and then "surf" down the other side, after having paused to admire the spectacular view from the top. Some stand as they race down, surfer-style, while others sit. All agree that it's exhilarating, though not everyone who does it is in a hurry to repeat it. "I've never experienced anything like it!" says Jamie White from London. "It's completely unique. But although it's great to be able to say I've done it, I'm in no rush to do it again! To steer, you hold onto a rope that's attached to the front of the board and pull it one way or the other, but I'm not sure I did it right because I ended up crashing into some rocks. You can slow yourself down by keeping your feet in contact with the ground as you go. But again, I didn't quite get the hang of it, and I reached a really scary speed on the way down!"
Câu 1. Where do people go to take part in volcano boarding?
	A. Eastern Nicaragua
	*B. Western Nicaragua's Cerro Negro mountain
	C. London, England
	D. The coast of North America
Câu 2. How fast can participants travel on their specially adapted surfboards?
	A. 40 km per hour
	B. 60 km per hour
	*C. 80 km per hour
	D. 100 km per hour
Câu 3. What do participants do before surfing down the volcano?
	A. They swim in a lake.
	B. They buy a new surfboard.
	*C. They hike up the volcano and take a training class.
	D. They practise skiing on the mountain.
Câu 4. How can participants steer their boards?
	A. By moving their feet from side to side.
	B. By using a special motor.
	C. By leaning backwards only.
	*D. By pulling a rope attached to the front of the board.
Câu 5. Why was Jamie White reluctant to try volcano boarding again?
	A. He thought the activity was too expensive.
	B. He didn't enjoy the view from the top.
	*C. He crashed into rocks and reached a frightening speed.
	D. He was unable to climb the volcano.
------HẾT------
Hướng dẫn giải
Câu 1: Thấy Where → chọn Western Nicaragua's Cerro Negro (chú ý western, không phải Eastern)
Câu 2: Thấy How fast → bài ghi 80 km per hour → chọn 80 km per hour
Câu 3: Thấy before surfing → chọn hike up the volcano and take a training class
Câu 4: Thấy steer (lái) → bài ghi hold onto a rope → chọn pulling a rope attached to the front
